description: This file provides utility functions for handling and transforming API provider errors into user-friendly messages, preserving metadata for retry logic, UI display, and debugging. It includes functions for general error handling and specific handling for OpenAI-compatible providers.

methods.name: handleProviderError
methods.description: Transforms an error object into a user-friendly Error, preserving metadata such as status, errorDetails, code, and $metadata for UI and retry logic.

methods.name: handleOpenAIError
methods.description: A specialized wrapper for handleProviderError with default messagePrefix 'completion' for OpenAI-compatible providers.
